units.source_text: 由于放了暖气，车窗开始蒙上一层水蒸汽，窗外流动的原野渐渐暗淡下来，在窗玻璃上又半透明地映现出乘客的影像。

en.t: Because the heating had been turned on, the train window began to mist over with vapor; the fields flowing past outside gradually darkened, and the passengers' images appeared again, half-transparent, in the glass.

units.source_text: 这就是在夕阳映照的镜面上变幻无穷的景色。

en.t: This was the endlessly changing scene on the mirror lit by the setting sun.

units.source_text: 旧得褪了色的老式客车，只挂上三四节车厢，好像不是东海道线上，而是别的地方的火车。

en.t: The old-fashioned passenger cars, faded with age, had only three or four carriages attached, and seemed not like a train on the Tokaido Line but one from somewhere else.
The lights were dim as well.
